title: Perimeter Violation Properties
description: Detects unauthorized crossing of a defined virtual line or protected perimeter within a surveillance area. Captures the line name, object classification type, and associated zone information. Use this event when queries involve boundary breaches, restricted area entry, or perimeter security violations.

linename.description: Name of the virtual line or boundary that was crossed.

type.description: Classification of the detected object involved in the perimeter violation (e.g., person, vehicle).

Zone.description: Identifier or name of the zone associated with the perimeter violation event.
